Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India has been filed to set aside the impugned order dated 21.06.2025 passed by Additional Session Judge, Court No. 16, Prayagraj in Criminal Revision No. 775/2024 and order dated 21.09.2024 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 2, Prayagraj in Case No. 1940/2021, (State Vs. Sanjay Soni and others), Case Crime No. 209/2020, under sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S., Shivkuti, District Prayagraj and further prayed to stay the effect and operation of the aforesaid proceedings.
